AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
1.
Meeting of May 29, 2019
Minutes
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
1.
Thank You and Recognition to out-going committee members, Ela Jhaveri and Don Culler, for their contributions and efforts made towards the Finance Advisory Committee’s goals and objectives.
2.
Discussion of Future Agenda Items. Staff will provide an overview of the topics tentatively calendared for future City Council and for future Finance Advisory Committee meetings. Staff will address updates on Unaudited Year-End Financial Report presentation, Fiscal Health sustainability report, RFP for new financial software, Equipment Replacement Fund and Reserve Policy, Welcome and Introduce new FAC members, Action plan for General Fund Forecast refresh.
3.
Review and Discuss the update on HR Green’s Capital Needs Assessment. This includes an update on work plan and final format of product and level of detail needed.
4.
Discussion of General Fund reserve and one time revenue policy draft. Review and discuss sample draft in relation to establishing the City’s formal policy and set timeline to complete.
5.
Review and Discuss the Equipment Replacement Fund and Reserve Policy. Discuss final format and timeline to complete and present to FAC. Currently scheduled for July meeting.
6.
Discussion of Financial Strategic Plan. The City Manager to discuss and provide an update on the plan to develop a financial strategy.
7.
Discussion on Forecasting Other City’s Funds. Discuss the strategy on completing the forecast for other City funds, such as special revenue funds, Gas Tax, RMRA, Measure M, etc to be included in the City’s ten year financial forecast.
8.
Review and Summarize Council’s discussion and/or conclusion of the June 11, 2019 and June 25, 2019 council meetings. No action required, only for discussion purposes. WRITTEN COMMUNICATION
